name: Pluck: Copy Screen Text
subtitle: Copy text from your screen
description:
Copy the uncopyable.

Pluck turns words on your screen into text you can paste anywhere. Press Command-Shift-2, drag around the words you want, and paste. Use it with screenshots, videos, PDFs, presentations, and other apps.

• Recognize text on your Mac with Apple's built-in OCR.
• Open an image to copy its words without changing the original.
• Reopen or copy your last result from the menu bar.
• Choose another shortcut or adjust recognition settings.

No account, ads, analytics, or uploaded screenshots. Pluck takes a still image only when you trigger capture, keeps it in memory, and captures no audio. The latest recognized text and your settings are saved locally.

Pluck began as a challenge to build a very small Mac app that does something practical. It uses the frameworks already on your Mac, with no bundled OCR model or web runtime.

Requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14 or later. macOS Screen Recording permission is required for screen capture; image import works without it.
reviewNotes:
Pluck is a native macOS menu-bar utility. Its main window appears on launch; it remains available from the menu bar after closing the window. No account or sign-in is required.

Screen capture: press Command-Shift-2 or click Capture text. Grant Screen & System Audio Recording permission to Pluck in System Settings when macOS asks, then quit and reopen Pluck if macOS requires it. macOS may also show a ScreenCaptureKit confirmation; allow it to continue. Drag one rectangle around visible text and release the mouse. The recognized text is copied to the clipboard. Escape cancels. No audio is captured.

Image import: click Open image and choose a PNG or JPEG containing text. Recognition uses Vision entirely on device. The sandbox grants read-only access to the user-selected image.

The latest recognized text and preferences persist only on the Mac. Privacy policy is available in the Pluck menu. If another copy of Pluck is running, quit it first to release the exclusive global shortcut.

This build supports Apple Silicon Macs only.

Screenshot artwork: the four product images are AI-generated illustrative compositions with fictional website/app content showing screen-region selection and extracted clipboard text. The "Copied text" cards and connector arrows explain the result; they are not separate Pluck popup interfaces. Pluck operates through screen capture and local OCR, without integrations with the depicted apps.
